Yeah, you must have another thing here.
Okay. On this session for the Deluxe label made in January of '46, you're reunited with the Benny Carter Orchestra.
Do you remember how those sides came about?

Well Benny had the recording session, and he just got in touch with me and had me to come in and record with him those two selections. I don't know where Benny had been in the meantime. I guess he'd been out on the road, or came in from California, or somewhere. But I know he called me up and said he had this record date. And I sang these couple of songs with him.
